newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary to continue MOL sell-off - APV.
newsitem.headline: Hungary to continue MOL sell-off - APV.

text.p: Hungary's privatisation agency APV Rt will continue the sell-off of oil and gas company Magyar Olaj- es Gazipari Rt (MOL), APV said in a statement on Thursday.
"APV will offer its available MOL shares in capital market transactions," the statement said.
APV Rt holds an 58 percent stake in MOL, which has issued share capital of 98.4 billion forints and the privatisation law says APV has to retain a 25 percent plus one share stake in the company.
APV officials were not immediately available for comment.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange, MOL shares closed at 3,400 forints, up 220.
